benchmark pgvector pgvectorscale vs Qdrant 50M vector: phương pháp đo + recall + tail latency + index build
findings.claim: Ở quy mô 50 triệu vector (768 chiều), PostgreSQL kết hợp pgvector và pgvectorscale đạt throughput 471.57 QPS ở mức recall 99% (gấp 11.4 lần Qdrant với 41.47 QPS) và 1,589.79 QPS ở mức recall 90% (gấp 4.4 lần Qdrant với 360.81 QPS).
findings.evidence_quote: Postgres with pgvector and pgvectorscale shows a substantial advantage in processing capacity, handling 471.57 queries per second compared to Qdrant's 41.47 QPS. This 11.4x performance gap suggests Postgres may be better suited for high-throughput applications where maintaining high recall is critical.

routes: hybrid search local: Qdrant Query API BM25 miniCOIL fusion vs Weaviate vs pgvector full-text
findings.claim: Weaviate hỗ trợ hybrid search kết hợp vector search và keyword (BM25F) search out-of-the-box với tham số alpha (0 = BM25 thuần, 1 = vector thuần) và hai thuật toán fusion: relativeScoreFusion (mặc định từ v1.24, chuẩn hóa điểm về 0..1) và rankedFusion (tính theo thứ hạng).
findings.evidence_quote: Hybrid search combines the results of a vector search and a keyword (BM25F) search by fusing the two result sets. The fusion method and the relative weights are configurable. relativeScoreFusion: The default method since Weaviate v1.24. It normalizes the scores from both the vector and keyword searches so that the highest score becomes 1 and the lowest becomes 0.

routes: hybrid search local: Qdrant Query API BM25 miniCOIL fusion vs Weaviate vs pgvector full-text
findings.claim: Qdrant Query API (từ v1.10.0) hỗ trợ hybrid search chạy local/server-side thông qua cơ chế prefetch nhiều sub-queries (kết hợp dense vector và sparse vector như BM25/miniCOIL) và dung hợp kết quả bằng thuật toán RRF (Reciprocal Rank Fusion) hoặc DBSF (Distribution-Based Score Fusion).
findings.evidence_quote: The Query API (introduced in version 1.10.0) provides a unified, server-side interface for performing complex, multi-stage retrieval, including hybrid search where results from multiple vectors (e.g., dense and sparse) are combined. The fusion of results is achieved through the prefetch parameter, which allows you to execute multiple sub-queries in parallel, and a fusion method that determines how those results are merged.

findings.claim: FAISS (từ Meta) tối ưu hóa truy vấn vector mật độ cao ở quy mô cực lớn (hàng tỷ vector) nhờ các kỹ thuật nén nén mã hóa (quantization), hỗ trợ tăng tốc mạnh mẽ qua GPU nhưng không phải là một database hoàn chỉnh có quản lý metadata phức tạp.
findings.evidence_quote: Faiss contains several methods for similarity search... Some of the methods, like those based on binary vectors and compact quantization codes, solely use a compressed representation of the vectors and do not require to keep the original vectors. This generally comes at the cost of a less precise search but these methods can scale to billions of vectors in main memory on a single server.

routes: giới hạn embedded local: sqlite-vec ANN roadmap + Milvus Lite concurrency + LanceDB IVF-PQ disk
findings.claim: Milvus Lite hoạt động như một thư viện đơn tiến trình (single-process) sử dụng cơ chế file locking. Mặc dù máy chủ gRPC tích hợp hỗ trợ đọc đồng thời (concurrent reads), việc ghi đồng thời (concurrent writes) vào cùng một collection không được hỗ trợ an toàn.
findings.evidence_quote: Milvus Lite runs as a single process. It uses a local file for data storage and employs file locking to protect this local storage. While the gRPC server integrated into Milvus Lite supports concurrent reads, concurrent writes to the same collection are not supported safely.

findings.claim: sqlite-vec (tác giả chính thức): chỉ brute-force, giới hạn lộ rõ ở 1 triệu vector — float vector không dim nào qua nổi smoke test 100ms (192d mất 192ms, 3072d mất 8.52s); binary quantization mới kéo về ~124ms. Phù hợp <1M vector hoặc bitvector.
findings.evidence_quote: However, the limits of `sqlite-vec` really show at 1 million vectors. The results: None of the float vectors at any dimension pass the 100ms smoke test — the 3072 dimension vectors take a whooping 8.52s to return, and even the tiny 192-dimensional vectors take 192ms.

routes: scout: vector database chạy local cho RAG 2026

findings.evidence_quote: We found that pgvecto.rs achieved a Queries per Second (QPS) rate of 1,068 with a recall of 0.6344, while Milvus achieved a QPS rate of 106 with a recall of 0.9842.

routes: scout: vector database chạy local cho RAG 2026

findings.evidence_quote: June 2026 update: Full Text Search has landed in VectorDBBench. We now benchmark BM25-style retrieval across supported backends, starting with MS MARCO and HotpotQA datasets, payload profiles, recall, QPS, and load metrics ready to compare.

routes: scout: vector database chạy local cho RAG 2026

findings.evidence_quote: Available as of v1.10.0 With the introduction of multiple named vectors per point, there are use-cases when the best search is obtained by combining multiple queries, or by performing the search in more than one stage. Qdrant has a flexible and universal interface to make this possible, called `Query API`

routes: scout: vector database chạy local cho RAG 2026
findings.claim: Chroma sau rewrite Rust-core v1.0 (2025) nhanh hơn 4x bản Python, nhưng throughput vẫn sập theo scale: ~2,000-5,000 QPS ở 100K vector rơi xuống ~112 QPS ở 10M vector, trong khi Qdrant/Milvus giữ hàng nghìn QPS ở 10M.
findings.evidence_quote: Benchmarks show Chroma achieving ~2,000-5,000 QPS at 100K vectors but dropping to ~112 QPS at 10 million vectors. For comparison, Qdrant and Milvus maintain thousands of QPS at 10M vectors. The Rust-core rewrite in v1.0 improved this significantly (4x faster than the pure-Python predecessor), but Chroma is still not designed to compete with production databases on raw throughput.

routes: scout: vector database chạy local cho RAG 2026

findings.evidence_quote: LanceDB is an open-source embedded vector database built on the Lance columnar format. It runs in-process with zero-copy access to data, making it fast for local workloads without a running server.

routes: scout: vector database chạy local cho RAG 2026
